naslov: Isaiah Mobley officially signs with Manresa
tekst:
By Stefan Acevski / info@eurohoops.net
After adding Luka Scuka to the roster, Manresa secured another signing.
Manresa officially lands Isaiah Mobley, a power forward with a Bahamian passport, as it was already reported by Spanish reporter Chema de Lucas.
Mobley spent most of his career in the NBA and G League, playing for the Philadelphia 76ers and Cleveland Cavaliers, as well as the Cleveland Charge and Delaware Blue Coats.
His first European club was Manisa in 2025, followed by a season at Hapoel Jerusalem. He is the brother of Cleveland Cavaliers starter Evan Mobley.
